standard_prerequisites.name: Parasitic kernel and cokernel of the adjunction map
Flat pullback preserves parasitic modules
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Cohomology of Algebraic Stacks, Lemma stacks-cohomology-lemma-parasitic (1)
standard_prerequisites.use: Keeps the defect parasitic after pullback.

standard_prerequisites.name: Parasitic cohomology exactness criterion
standard_prerequisites.use: Parasitic kernel and cokernel in QCoh imply the map is an isomorphism.

core_obligations: f^* preserves QCoh and LQCoh^{fbc} (Sheaves on Stacks pullback-qc lemma and the loc-qcoh-fbc proposition) (proof lines 1822-1826).

The adjunction map Q_Y(F) -> F has parasitic kernel and cokernel (lemma-adjoint-kernel-parasitic); since f is flat, pulling back keeps kernel and cokernel parasitic (lemma-parasitic (1)) (proof lines 1827-1833).
The induced map f^*Q_Y(F) -> Q_X(f^*F) has parasitic kernel and cokernel, hence is an isomorphism by the parasitic exactness criterion (proof lines 1834-1838).
proof_roadmap: Track the adjunction map through the flat pullback and conclude via the parasitic criterion.
difficulty_reason: Four-step comparison: f^* preserves both categories (cited), the adjunction map has parasitic kernel and cokernel (cited), flat pullback keeps them parasitic (cited parasitic lemma), and the induced map between the pullback of Q and Q of the pullback is an isomorphism by the parasitic-cohomology exactness criterion.
